answer: An agent economy resists Sybil attacks by requiring each node to anchor its identity via a multi-party attestation trellis backed by locked stake. Subverting consensus forces the attacker to drain liquidity across an isolated capital lagoon, imposing a ruinous cost of O(k^2) in non-recoverable bonds.
